label: SCG I.22 dependence on another gives necessity from it
paraphrase: OPEN selected reading of SCG I.22 n.2's per se clause ('si ab alio dependet, iam non est necesse esse'), attribution deferred: for every esse e and every s other than e, if e depends absolutely on s, then s is a cause of e's necessity. Dependence on itself is not covered. Kept as a premise, not folded into the definition of per se necessity.
